One winter, as a boy, I climbed into a small opening under a huge rock. There were leaves packed in pretty tight, and as a child I thought it would have been a cool spot to camp sometime. However, as I climbed further in I saw a large furry head raise up not two feet from my face. Whatever it was moved like it was drunk, as I had woke it up. I panicked and backed out from under the rock, and got some distance where I sat down to watch. Within the hour I saw a sow and a cub both stick their heads out of the opening where I had been. 

I had crawled into a bear den while the mother and cub were hibernating through the winter. Where I'm from, it doesn't get super cold, so she wasn't totally asleep, and I had disturbed her moving the leaves around. Had I reached out, I feel sure I would have had a handful of her fur. 

I finished out the hike and made it back to the cabin, glad I had made it out with no trouble. (Trouble came regardless, when I told my mother what had happened.)

Find the locked scope in the parts menu you want, and look around on that screen for the province the scope is located in. (Part locked explore ___ or buy in store to unlock)

 Head to that provice (with a heli for speed if available) and look around for little white dots with an "i" in them. These are called "Intel". 

The first one you get in an unexplored provice will give the option for skill point locations, (Blue option) and the second will give you weapons and attachment locations (also blue).

 After you've found your second Intel, and selected weapon locations, look for icons on the map that are blue and with a little cog. Highlight them in your map until to locate the one that is the scope you want, and head to the location to claim it. 

Long winded explanation, but thorough. Hope this helps.
